summary.en: A 1 px hairline between two blocks of content that would otherwise run together, plain or with a few words in it (a date divider, "or"). Most of the time spacing or the component's own dividers are enough.
summary.id: Garis tipis 1 px di antara dua blok isi yang kalau tidak akan menyatu, polos atau dengan beberapa kata di dalamnya (pemisah tanggal, "atau"). Sering kali jarak atau pemisah bawaan komponen sudah cukup.

en.title: Inside a card
en.desc: The hairline splits the summary from its footer. Margin comes from the layout, not the separator.
en.html:
Posyandu visits
Your child has been weighed 5 months in a row.
Next session: today at 09:00

en.title: Date dividers in a feed
en.desc: A labeled separator starts each day. `sep-label--start` drops the left hairline so the date lines up with the rows; `sep-label--sticky` keeps it at the top of a scrolling list while that day is in view.
en.html:
